title: Each strip line is sized by the runs on it: 8 pt br-lines under an 11 pt first line pitch 8 x 1.15 (strip 31.05, body stays), three 11 pt lines push the body; an 8 + 11 pt single line is the 11 pt line; a space-only run is sized by the mark
source:
probe build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF (2026-10-29), pymupdf: Letter 1440 margins, header 720, docDefaults Calibri 11; `11pt bold TNR
8pt
8pt` baselines 46.32 / 56.16 / 65.28 with the body at 72.05 (strip 31.05 under the 36 pt reserve), three 11 pt TNR lines baselines 46.32 / 58.80 / 71.52 push the body to 73.97 (37.95); `Small (8pt) and large (11pt)` baseline 46.32; four paragraphs holding one sz 32 space under a sz 16 TNR mark over a Calibri line push the body to 86.21 = 36 + 4 x 9.2 + 13.42. gen's strip strut was the largest declared size, shrink-only against the strip default, so the 8 pt lines took the 11 pt pitch

cases.note: smallest declared size carries the strut; the 11 pt run lays its own box
one line of 8 + 11 pt runs: the 11 pt span grows the line to the 11 pt pitch
space-only sz 32 run under a sz 16 Times New Roman mark: the mark sizes the line
